label: a5-qwen38-27b-tp8-pp2-prefill

machine.clock_caveat: two hosts differ by a fixed 24.878 s clock offset; only durations are used, so the offset cancels

protocol.workload: prefill-only P node (no D node, no KV transfer)
protocol.c4_note: c4 TTFT is engine-serialised (per-request queue positions 1-4) and is not a pipeline-parallel property
protocol.chunk_note: p16k = 2 chunks, p64k = 8 chunks; a 4k prompt is one chunk

per_die_efficiency_vs_tp1.derivation: speedup over the same single-die TP1 run divided by the number of dies
per_die_efficiency_vs_tp1.note: PP2 is 2x less efficient per die at 4k and 1.3x at 64k; the headline 6.34x vs TP1 is mostly TP8 (PP1 4.13x)

p2p.note: 4 hcom_send + 4 hcom_receive kernels; 3 of each are pure (0.05-0.06 ms), one send blocks 11.07 ms and one receive blocks 38.14 ms - synchronisation, not bandwidth; 84 MiB is about 2 ms on the link

trace.note: p16384 c1 is 2 chunks of 8192 tokens; stage1 kernel/wall is higher at equal 32/32 layers because MTP + final norm + lm_head run on the last stage

uneven_partition.conclusion: even 32/32 is the measured optimum; 40/24 makes stage0 the bottleneck and starves stage1

anomalies: the p16k c1 first sample reported an empty first delta; the clean re-run is the cell used here
the c4 cells are engine-serialised and do not isolate PP

tp1_ttft_ms.source: measured TP1 single-die baseline, campaign qwen38-longctx (same model/recipe)
